claim: Seventeen headless probes, four interactive terminal cases run through a login shell after the host launcher was replaced by the repository-generated one, the launcher's repository tests and the installed binary's settings schema, all on Claude Code 2.1.284 and each read from the model and effort the client recorded in its own transcript, found that: (1) with the host's saved xhigh per-model levels and ultracode true, a Sonnet 5.5 and an Opus 5.5 session ran at xhigh, and --effort max ran both at max with the Ultracode reminder present; (2) in a --effort max session a Workflow stage naming no effort and an unnamed subagent ran at max, a stage naming effort low ran at low and a subagent whose definition says medium ran at medium, whereas with CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max supplied through the --settings env layer the low stage and the medium subagent both ran at max and the variable also overrode an explicit --effort low; (3) --effort max with ultracode false ran at max with the reminder absent and its Workflow stages kept their own efforts; (4) the binary's settings schema lists only low, medium, high and xhigh for effortLevel and modelSettings.<model>.effortLevel, so a saved max is dropped, and its Ultracode gate reads the ultracode setting or an ultracode effort choice, with no effort term; (5) an interactive Sonnet 5.5 session started through a login shell with the installed launcher ran at max, ran at xhigh after /effort xhigh, ran at xhigh when launched with an explicit --effort xhigh, and claude -p inside a terminal ran at xhigh (the launcher went from 165 bytes to 1,810 bytes, through a first 911-byte version that a cross-family review sent back for repair); and (6) --effort max on Haiku 4.5 completed with exit 0 and empty stderr and no effort field was recorded for either Haiku run.
limitations: Local observation of one workstation and one client version (2.1.284); not a provider ledger, and the recorded effort field is the client's own per-message record, not an API-side confirmation.

The headless probes are one-turn sessions in fresh scratch directories that read the host's user settings (shape only: ultracode true, a top-level effortLevel of xhigh, and per-model levels of xhigh for Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5); other settings would change the baselines.

The environment-variable route was supplied through the --settings flag's env block (cases E1 to E4), not through a shell export or the user settings file, and the documented reapplication of settings env values to running sessions was not probed.

For the three Workflow cases the Workflow tool result is only a launch receipt; execution is shown by the two child transcripts (attributed by the stage token in each child's first message, never by session id or file order), the workflow journal and the completion notification. The Ultracode reminder is matched as the full phrase 'Ultracode is on: optimize' and is an indicator, not proof of orchestration; orchestration was exercised only where the prompt ordered a Workflow launch.
Haiku 4.5 rows carry no effort field at all (the client marks per-turn effort inactive), so the transcript cannot show what became of --effort max on that model.

Each interactive case is one Sonnet 5.5 session driven through tmux with the workspace-trust dialog answered yes for a scratch directory (one entry added to the client's trust state); the /effort xhigh command re-saved the user settings file with identical bytes (its mtime moved, its sha256 did not). A first 911-byte version of the launcher went through the same four cases before a cross-family review sent it back for repair; those runs are not part of this receipt, and a later pre-flight of the repaired launcher lost two of its rows to a harness defect (a leftover transcript satisfied a reply check) and is not used either.

Not covered: the VS Code extension, the desktop app and the web client, which do not go through the launcher; a host whose bin directory is ~/.local/bin, where no launcher is written; macOS (not run); and the Windows Terminal profile itself (the login-shell route it takes was exercised through tmux).

An independent stack-verifier re-derived all seventeen headless rows from the raw transcripts with its own extraction code (17 of 17 matched); that verdict is recorded by the coordinator, not by a script in this receipt.

The transcripts hold local identifiers and are not retained; the scripts in provenance reproduce every row given the results files they write, and scratch paths and session identifiers are replaced in them.
Nothing here compares answer quality across effort levels; the vendor and third-party effort comparisons are cited in docs/decisions/2026-09-29-max-default-effort.md, not measured here.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Probe library for the max-default-effort question on Claude Code 2.1.284.
# One headless session per case, each in a fresh scratch directory, reading the host's real user settings
# (ultracode true, saved xhigh per model) and nothing else written to host files. Method after the reference harness in
# evidence/receipts/claude-model-effort-probes-20260929.json (provenance.scripts run.sh / extract_all.py).
set -u
BASE="${BASE:?BASE required}"
GROUP="${GROUP:?GROUP required}"
mkdir -p "$BASE"
: > "$BASE/results-$GROUP.tsv"

PROBE='Reply with exactly the text PROBE-OK and nothing else. Do not use any tools.'

WF='Call the Workflow tool exactly once. Pass this as the script, unchanged:

export const meta = { name: "effort-probe", description: "effort probe" }
const a = await agent("STAGE-NONE: reply with exactly STAGE-NONE-OK and nothing else. Do not use tools.", { label: "stage-none", model: "sonnet" })
const b = await agent("STAGE-LOW: reply with exactly STAGE-LOW-OK and nothing else. Do not use tools.", { label: "stage-low", model: "sonnet", effort: "low" })
return { a, b }

After the Workflow tool returns, reply with exactly WORKFLOW-DONE followed by a space and the JSON it returned.'

AGENT_UNNAMED='Use the Agent tool exactly once with subagent_type general-purpose, model sonnet and prompt "CHILD-UNNAMED: reply with exactly CHILD-OK and nothing else". Then reply with exactly AGENT-DONE followed by a space and the child answer.'

AGENT_MEDIUM='Use the Agent tool exactly once with subagent_type scout-medium and prompt "CHILD-MEDIUM: go". Then reply with exactly AGENT-DONE followed by a space and the child answer.'

MEDIUM_AGENT_SETUP='mkdir -p .claude/agents && printf "%s\n" "---" "name: scout-medium" "description: Probe agent whose frontmatter effort is medium" "model: sonnet" "effort: medium" "tools: Read" "---" "Reply with exactly CHILD-OK and nothing else." > .claude/agents/scout-medium.md'

run_case() {
  local name="$1" prompt="$2" turns="$3"; shift 3
  local dir="$BASE/case-$name"
  rm -rf "$dir"; mkdir -p "$dir"
  if [ -n "${SETUP:-}" ]; then ( cd "$dir" && bash -c "$SETUP" ); fi
  ( cd "$dir" && timeout 1500 claude -p "$prompt" --max-turns "$turns" --output-format json "$@" \
      < /dev/null > "$BASE/out-$name.json" 2> "$BASE/err-$name.txt"; echo "rc=$?" > "$BASE/rc-$name.txt" )
  echo "$name $dir" >> "$BASE/results-$GROUP.tsv"
}

scripts.interactive_e2e.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Real interactive end-to-end check of the claude launcher, driven through tmux.

Each case starts the client the way a person (or the Windows Terminal profile) does, types into the terminal, and reads the
effort the client itself recorded for each assistant message in its transcript. Nothing here reads a credential.

Usage: interactive_e2e.py <label> [--launcher-dir DIR] [--cases I1,I2,I3,I4]
  --launcher-dir DIR  prepend DIR (holding an executable `claude`) to PATH inside the login shell, for the pre-flight run
                      before the host launcher is replaced; without it the login shell's own PATH decides (the installed
                      state, the route the NativeStack - Claude Windows Terminal profile takes: bash -lc "exec claude").
Cases: I1 interactive launch, no effort flag; I2 the same session lowered with /effort xhigh; I3 interactive launch with an
explicit --effort xhigh; I4 `claude -p` in a terminal (headless in a tty).
"""
import argparse
import glob
import json
import os
import re
import secrets
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PROJECTS = os.path.expanduser("~/.claude/projects")
DROP = ("CLAUDE", "CODEX", "ANTHROPIC", "OTEL_", "AI_MEMORY", "MCP_")
NONCE = secrets.token_hex(3)  # per run: a transcript left by an earlier run of the same case must never satisfy a reply check


def clean_env():
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(DROP) and k != "CLAUDECODE"}
    env["TERM"] = "xterm-256color"
    return env


def tmux(*args):
    # a dedicated socket (-L) keeps this harness away from every other tmux session on the host
    return subprocess.run(["tmux", "-L", "nas-effort-e2e", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=clean_env())


def pane(session):
    return tmux("capture-pane", "-p", "-J", "-t", session).stdout


def project_dir(case_dir):
    """The client's transcript directory for a working directory (its encoding replaces / and _ and . with -)."""
    enc = re.sub(r"[/_.]", "-", case_dir)
    hits = glob.glob(os.path.join(PROJECTS, enc)) or glob.glob(os.path.join(PROJECTS, "*" + os.path.basename(case_dir)))
    return hits[0] if hits else None


def transcript(case_dir):
    d = project_dir(case_dir)
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "*.jsonl")), key=os.path.getmtime) if d else []
    return files[-1] if files else None


def assistant_rows(path):
    seen, order = {}, []
    reminder = 0
    versions = set()
    for line in open(path, errors="replace"):
        if "Ultracode is on: optimize" in line:
            reminder += 1
        try:
            row = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if row.get("version"):
            versions.add(row["version"])
        msg = row.get("message") or {}
        if msg.get("role") == "assistant" and msg.get("model") not in (None, "<synthetic>"):
            mid = msg.get("id")
            text = " ".join(b.get("text", "") for b in (msg.get("content") or []) if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "text")
            if mid not in seen:
                seen[mid] = {"model": msg["model"], "effort": str(row.get("effort")), "text": text, "ts": row.get("timestamp")}
                order.append(mid)
            elif text:
                seen[mid]["text"] += " " + text
    return [seen[m] for m in order], reminder, sorted(versions)


def wait_for(cond, timeout, step=1.0, what=""):
    end = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < end:
        got = cond()
        if got:
            return got
        time.sleep(step)
    raise TimeoutError("timed out waiting for " + what)


def handle_dialogs(session):
    """Answer the startup dialogs a fresh working directory can show; returns the pane text once it is stable."""
    last, stable_since = None, time.time()
    end = time.time() + 120
    answered = 0
    while time.time() < end:
        text = pane(session)
        if re.search(r"Yes, I trust this folder", text) and answered < 3:
            # the dialog's default row is "No, exit": move to the "Yes" row explicitly, then confirm
            if re.search(r"❯\s*No", text):
                tmux("send-keys", "-t", session, "Down")
                time.sleep(0.5)
            tmux("send-keys", "-t", session, "Enter")
            answered += 1
            time.sleep(3)
            last, stable_since = None, time.time()
            continue
        if text == last and text.strip():
            if time.time() - stable_since >= 4:
                return text
        else:
            last, stable_since = text, time.time()
        time.sleep(1)
    raise TimeoutError("startup never settled; last pane:\n" + (last or ""))


def send(session, text):
    tmux("send-keys", "-t", session, "-l", text)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    tmux("send-keys", "-t", session, "Enter")


def reply_count(case_dir, token):
    path = transcript(case_dir)
    if not path:
        return 0
    rows, _, _ = assistant_rows(path)
    return sum(1 for r in rows if token in r["text"])


def ask(session, case_dir, token, timeout=240):
    before = reply_count(case_dir, token)
    send(session, f"Reply with exactly the text {token} and nothing else. Do not use any tools.")
    wait_for(lambda: reply_count(case_dir, token) > before, timeout, 2, "reply containing " + token)


def launch(session, case_dir, command, launcher_dir):
    os.makedirs(case_dir, exist_ok=True)
    prefix = "export PATH=%s:\"$PATH\"; " % shlex.quote(launcher_dir) if launcher_dir else ""
    inner = prefix + command
    tmux("kill-session", "-t", session)
    r = tmux("new-session", "-d", "-s", session, "-x", "200", "-y", "50", "-c", case_dir, "bash", "-lc", inner)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("tmux new-session failed: " + r.stderr)


def summarize(case_dir):
    path = transcript(case_dir)
    if not path:
        return {"error": "no transcript"}
    rows, reminder, versions = assistant_rows(path)
    return {"assistant_messages": len(rows),
            "model_effort": [(r["model"], r["effort"]) for r in rows],
            "reminder_lines": reminder, "versions": versions}


def case_interactive(label, name, extra_args, launcher_dir, lower_to=None):
    case_dir = os.path.join(BASE, "interactive", f"case-{label}-{name}")
    session = f"e2e-{label}-{name}"
    result = {"case": name, "command": "claude --model sonnet" + (" " + extra_args if extra_args else ""),
              "route": "bash -lc (login shell), PATH " + ("prefixed with a temporary launcher directory" if launcher_dir else "as installed")}
    launch(session, case_dir, f"exec claude --model sonnet {extra_args}", launcher_dir)
    try:
        handle_dialogs(session)
        ask(session, case_dir, "ALPHA-" + name + "-" + NONCE + "-1")
        result["first_turn"] = summarize(case_dir)
        if lower_to:
            send(session, f"/effort {lower_to}")
            time.sleep(6)
            text = pane(session)
            if re.search(r"(?i)(cache|confirm|continue|\(y/n\))", text) and re.search(r"(?i)effort", text) and "Set effort" not in text:
                tmux("send-keys", "-t", session, "Enter")
                time.sleep(3)
            ask(session, case_dir, "BRAVO-" + name + "-" + NONCE + "-2")
            result["after_effort_command"] = summarize(case_dir)
            result["pane_after_command"] = [l.strip() for l in pane(session).splitlines() if re.search(r"(?i)effort", l)][-3:]
        send(session, "/exit")
        time.sleep(3)
    except Exception as exc:  # keep the evidence of a failed case
        result["error"] = repr(exc)
        result["pane_tail"] = [l for l in pane(session).splitlines() if l.strip()][-14:]
    finally:
        tmux("kill-session", "-t", session)
    return result


def case_print(label, name, launcher_dir):
    case_dir = os.path.join(BASE, "interactive", f"case-{label}-{name}")
    session = f"e2e-{label}-{name}"
    out = os.path.join(case_dir, "out.json")
    result = {"case": name, "command": "claude -p <prompt> --model sonnet (run inside a terminal)",
              "route": "bash -lc (login shell), PATH " + ("prefixed with a temporary launcher directory" if launcher_dir else "as installed")}
    cmd = "claude -p 'Reply with exactly the text CHARLIE-%s and nothing else. Do not use any tools.' --model sonnet --output-format json > %s; echo done > %s" % (
        name, shlex.quote(out), shlex.quote(os.path.join(case_dir, "DONE")))
    launch(session, case_dir, cmd, launcher_dir)
    try:
        wait_for(lambda: os.path.exists(os.path.join(case_dir, "DONE")), 240, 2, "the -p run")
        result["run"] = summarize(case_dir)
    except Exception as exc:
        result["error"] = repr(exc)
    finally:
        tmux("kill-session", "-t", session)
    return result


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("label")
    ap.add_argument("--launcher-dir")
    ap.add_argument("--cases", default="I1,I2,I3,I4")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    wanted = a.cases.split(",")
    results = []
    if "I1" in wanted or "I2" in wanted:
        # one session serves I1 (first turn, no flag) and I2 (the same session lowered by /effort xhigh)
        r = case_interactive(a.label, "I1I2", "", a.launcher_dir, lower_to="xhigh")
        results.append(r)
    if "I3" in wanted:
        results.append(case_interactive(a.label, "I3", "--effort xhigh", a.launcher_dir))
    if "I4" in wanted:
        results.append(case_print(a.label, "I4", a.launcher_dir))
    out = os.path.join(BASE, f"interactive-{a.label}.json")
    json.dump(results, open(out, "w"), indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
    print("wrote", out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the claude launcher with the repository's own install_native (both bootstrap scripts), exactly as the tests do,
so the bytes that reach a host are what the generator writes. Usage: gen_launcher.py <checkout> <out_dir>."""
import hashlib
import os
import re
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

STUB_INSTALLER = (
    "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n"
    "mkdir -p \"$HOME/.local/share/claude/versions\" \"$HOME/.local/bin\"\n"
    "printf 'REAL-BINARY\\n' > \"$HOME/.local/share/claude/versions/$2\"\n"
    "ln -sfn \"$HOME/.local/share/claude/versions/$2\" \"$HOME/.local/bin/claude\"\n"
)


def generate(script: Path) -> bytes:
    text = script.read_text()
    match = re.search(r"(?ms)^install_native\(\) \{.*?^\}$", text)
    assert match, script
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        home = Path(tmp)
        bin_dir = home / "eco" / "bin"
        bin_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        stub = home / "stub-installer"
        stub.write_text(STUB_INSTALLER)
        harness = (
            f"set -euo pipefail\ncache_dir={shlex.quote(str(home / 'cache'))}\n"
            f"bin_dir={shlex.quote(str(bin_dir))}\nmkdir -p \"$cache_dir\" \"$bin_dir\"\n"
            f"fetch() {{ cp {shlex.quote(str(stub))} \"$3\"; }}\n" + match.group(0)
            + "\ninstall_native claude-code 2.1.280 https://example.invalid/claude 0 claude\n")
        env = dict(os.environ, HOME=str(home))
        r = subprocess.run(["bash", "-c", harness], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=60)
        assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
        return (bin_dir / "claude").read_bytes()


checkout, out_dir = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
linux = generate(checkout / "adoption/bootstrap-linux.sh")
mac = generate(checkout / "adoption/bootstrap-macos.sh")
assert linux == mac, "the two generators disagree"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
target = out_dir / "claude"
target.write_bytes(linux)
target.chmod(0o755)
print("wrote", target, "sha256", hashlib.sha256(linux).hexdigest(), "bytes", len(linux))
scripts.host_apply_launcher.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replace the host's plain claude launcher with the repository-generated one (backup first, atomic rename, read-back).

Usage: host_apply_launcher.py <generated launcher file> [--apply]
Without --apply it only checks. It refuses unless the current host file is exactly the known plain 3-line launcher (so it never
overwrites a hand edit) or is already the new launcher (idempotent)."""
import hashlib
import os
import shutil
import stat
import sys
import tempfile

TARGET = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/claude")
BACKUP = TARGET + ".bak-20260929-max-default"
BACKUP_V1 = TARGET + ".bak-20260929-max-default-v1"
V1_SHA = "7f642f9ce51098bf11f262da4b2478b2c1474350e04d6ff828c6f91843208a18"  # first applied version, replaced after review
PLAIN = (b'#!/usr/bin/env bash\n'
         b'# Native auto-updating launcher (installed by claude-code install); the ecosystem no longer pins a snapshot.\n'
         b'exec "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" "$@"\n')
new = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
apply = "--apply" in sys.argv
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
current = open(TARGET, "rb").read()
print("current sha256", sha(current), len(current), "bytes; plain launcher:", current == PLAIN, "; already new:", current == new)
print("new     sha256", sha(new), len(new), "bytes")
if current == new:
    print("nothing to do")
    sys.exit(0)
if current != PLAIN and sha(current) != V1_SHA:
    sys.exit("refusing: the host launcher is neither the known plain launcher, the first applied version nor the new one")
if not apply:
    print("check only (no --apply)")
    sys.exit(0)
backup = BACKUP if current == PLAIN else BACKUP_V1
if os.path.lexists(backup):
    sys.exit("refusing: backup already exists: " + backup)
shutil.copy2(TARGET, backup)
assert open(backup, "rb").read() == current
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(TARGET), prefix=".claude.", suffix=".tmp")
with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as f:
    f.write(new)
os.chmod(tmp, 0o755)
os.replace(tmp, TARGET)
after = open(TARGET, "rb").read()
mode = stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(TARGET).st_mode)

scripts.make_receipt_max.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build evidence/receipts/claude-max-default-effort-20260929.json (native_cli_e2e, claude-code) and register it.

Usage: make_receipt_max.py <checkout> [--register]

Every row is asserted against the client's own transcripts before it is written: expected model, the recorded effort of each
unique assistant message, the Ultracode-reminder presence (the full phrase), the tool calls, and the child transcripts attributed
by the stage token in their first message (never by session id or file order). The client version recorded in each transcript
must be 2.1.284, the installed binary's settings-schema windows must still list effortLevel without "max", the host launcher must
hash to the applied generator output with the backup at the recorded pre-change hash, and the repository tests are re-run here.
Scripts are stored with scratch paths and session identifiers replaced. --register only adds the manifest entry."""
import glob
import hashlib
import json
import mmap
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from read_probes import PROJECTS, load_result, summarize  # noqa: E402

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
REGISTER_ONLY = "--register" in sys.argv
RECEIPT_ID = "claude-max-default-effort-20260929"
RECEIPT_PATH = "evidence/receipts/%s.json" % RECEIPT_ID
VERSION = "2.1.284"
BINARY = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.284")
HOST_LAUNCHER = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/claude")
HOST_BACKUP = HOST_LAUNCHER + ".bak-20260929-max-default"
HOST_BACKUP_V1 = HOST_LAUNCHER + ".bak-20260929-max-default-v1"
OLD_SHA = "22c2d5188183cea7e411db2010c5533cc409170633456e39a52e2a33f0f45d26"
V1_SHA = "7f642f9ce51098bf11f262da4b2478b2c1474350e04d6ff828c6f91843208a18"  # first applied version, replaced after the cross-family review
GENERATED = HERE.parent / "preflight-bin-v2" / "claude"
NEW_SHA = hashlib.sha256(GENERATED.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
S, O, H = "claude-sonnet-5-5", "claude-opus-5-5", "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"

# case -> (model, main effort, reminder present, main tool_use, child effort by stage token)
EXPECT = {
    "C1-sonnet-baseline": (S, "xhigh", True, {}, {}),
    "C2-opus-baseline": (O, "xhigh", True, {}, {}),
    "C3-sonnet-max-ultracode-off": (S, "max", False, {}, {}),
    "C4-sonnet-max-ultracode-off-workflow": (S, "max", False, {"Workflow": 1}, {"STAGE-NONE": "max", "STAGE-LOW": "low"}),
    "F1-sonnet-max": (S, "max", True, {}, {}),
    "F2-opus-max": (O, "max", True, {}, {}),
    "F3-sonnet-max-then-low": (S, "low", True, {}, {}),
    "F4-sonnet-low-then-max": (S, "max", True, {}, {}),
    "F5-sonnet-max-workflow": (S, "max", True, {"Workflow": 1}, {"STAGE-NONE": "max", "STAGE-LOW": "low"}),
    "F6-sonnet-max-agent-unnamed": (S, "max", True, {"Agent": 1}, {"CHILD-UNNAMED": "max"}),
    "F7-sonnet-max-agent-medium": (S, "max", True, {"Agent": 1}, {"CHILD-MEDIUM": "medium"}),
    "E1-sonnet-envmax": (S, "max", True, {}, {}),
    "E2-sonnet-envmax-workflow": (S, "max", True, {"Workflow": 1}, {"STAGE-NONE": "max", "STAGE-LOW": "max"}),
    "E3-sonnet-envmax-flag-low": (S, "max", True, {}, {}),
    "E4-sonnet-envmax-agent-medium": (S, "max", True, {"Agent": 1}, {"CHILD-MEDIUM": "max"}),
    "H1-haiku-max": (H, "None", False, {}, {}),
    "H2-haiku-baseline": (H, "None", False, {}, {}),
}
ARGS = {
    "C1-sonnet-baseline": "--model sonnet",
    "C2-opus-baseline": "--model opus",
    "C3-sonnet-max-ultracode-off": "--model sonnet --effort max --settings '{\"ultracode\":false}'",
    "C4-sonnet-max-ultracode-off-workflow": "--model sonnet --effort max --settings '{\"ultracode\":false}'",
    "F1-sonnet-max": "--model sonnet --effort max",
    "F2-opus-max": "--model opus --effort max",
    "F3-sonnet-max-then-low": "--model sonnet --effort max --effort low",
    "F4-sonnet-low-then-max": "--model sonnet --effort low --effort max",
    "F5-sonnet-max-workflow": "--model sonnet --effort max",
    "F6-sonnet-max-agent-unnamed": "--model sonnet --effort max",
    "F7-sonnet-max-agent-medium": "--model sonnet --effort max",
    "E1-sonnet-envmax": "--model sonnet --settings '{\"env\":{\"CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL\":\"max\"}}'",
    "E2-sonnet-envmax-workflow": "--model sonnet --settings '{\"env\":{\"CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL\":\"max\"}}'",
    "E3-sonnet-envmax-flag-low": "--model sonnet --effort low --settings '{\"env\":{\"CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL\":\"max\"}}'",
    "E4-sonnet-envmax-agent-medium": "--model sonnet --settings '{\"env\":{\"CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL\":\"max\"}}'",
    "H1-haiku-max": "--model haiku --effort max",
    "H2-haiku-baseline": "--model haiku",
}
TASK = {
    "F5": "Workflow tool, two stage agents: one names no effort, one names effort low",
    "C4": "Workflow tool, two stage agents: one names no effort, one names effort low",
    "E2": "Workflow tool, two stage agents: one names no effort, one names effort low",
    "F6": "unnamed general-purpose Agent-tool subagent, model sonnet",
    "F7": "project agent whose frontmatter effort is medium",
    "E4": "project agent whose frontmatter effort is medium",
}
STAGE = re.compile(r"STAGE-NONE|STAGE-LOW|CHILD-UNNAMED|CHILD-MEDIUM")


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def clean(text):
    text = re.sub(r"<scratch>'\"]*", "<scratch>", text)
    text = re.sub(r"/home/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/", "~/", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[0-9a-f]{8}-(?:[0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12}", "<id>", text)
    return text


def transcript_times(path):
    stamps = [str(json.loads(l).get("timestamp")) for l in open(path, errors="replace") if l.strip().startswith("{") and '"timestamp"' in l]
    stamps = [s for s in stamps if s != "None"]
    return min(stamps)[:16] + "Z", max(stamps)[:16] + "Z"


def child_stage(path):
    first_user, efforts = None, set()
    for line in open(path, errors="replace"):
        try:
            row = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        msg = row.get("message") or {}
        if msg.get("role") == "user" and first_user is None:
            c = msg.get("content")
            first_user = c if isinstance(c, str) else " ".join(b.get("text", "") for b in c if isinstance(b, dict))
        if msg.get("role") == "assistant" and msg.get("model") not in (None, "<synthetic>"):
            efforts.add(str(row.get("effort")))
    tokens = sorted(set(STAGE.findall(first_user or "")))
    assert len(tokens) == 1 and len(efforts) == 1, (path, tokens, efforts)
    return tokens[0], next(iter(efforts))


def headless_rows():
    rows = []
    for tsv in ("results-c.tsv", "results-f.tsv", "results-e.tsv", "results-h.tsv"):
        for entry in open(HERE / tsv):
            name = entry.split()[0]
            res = load_result(name)
            sid = res.get("session_id")
            mains = glob.glob(os.path.join(PROJECTS, "*", sid + ".jsonl")) if sid else []
            assert mains, "%s: no transcript" % name
            main = summarize(mains[0])
            kids = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(mains[0]), sid, "**", "agent-*.jsonl"), recursive=True))
            by_stage = dict(child_stage(k) for k in kids)
            model, effort, reminder, tools, want_kids = EXPECT[name]
            assert res.get("is_error") is False, name
            assert main["versions"] == [VERSION], (name, main["versions"])
            assert main["models"] == {model: main["messages"]}, (name, main["models"])
            assert main["efforts"] == {effort: main["messages"]}, (name, main["efforts"])
            assert (main["reminder_lines"] > 0) == reminder, (name, main["reminder_lines"])
            assert main["tool_use"] == tools, (name, main["tool_use"])
            assert len(by_stage) == len(kids) and by_stage == want_kids, (name, by_stage, want_kids)
            first, last = transcript_times(mains[0])
            rows.append({
                "case": name.split("-")[0], "probe": name, "arguments": ARGS[name],
                "task": TASK.get(name.split("-")[0], "one-turn reply, no tools"),
                "resolved_model": model,
                "recorded_effort_main": "absent (the model takes no effort level)" if effort == "None" else effort,
                "ultracode_reminder_lines": main["reminder_lines"],
                "tool_calls_main": tools,
                "child_recorded_effort_by_stage_token": by_stage,
                "session_result": str(res.get("result"))[:60],
                "run_utc": first if first == last else "%s to %s" % (first, last),
            })
    return rows


def interactive_rows(label, expect_route):
    data = json.load(open(HERE / ("interactive-%s.json" % label)))
    by = {c["case"]: c for c in data}
    assert set(by) == {"I1I2", "I3", "I4"}, by.keys()
    for c in data:
        assert "error" not in c, c
        assert expect_route in c["route"], c["route"]
    a = by["I1I2"]
    assert a["first_turn"]["model_effort"] == [[S, "max"]], a["first_turn"]
    assert a["after_effort_command"]["model_effort"] == [[S, "max"], [S, "xhigh"]], a["after_effort_command"]
    assert by["I3"]["first_turn"]["model_effort"] == [[S, "xhigh"]]
    assert by["I4"]["run"]["model_effort"] == [[S, "xhigh"]]
    for c in data:
        for k in ("first_turn", "after_effort_command", "run"):
            if k in c:
                assert c[k]["versions"] == [VERSION] and c[k]["reminder_lines"] == 1, (label, c["case"], k, c[k])
    return [
        {"case": "I1", "launch": "claude --model sonnet (interactive, tmux, login shell)", "recorded_effort": "max", "reminder_lines": 1},
        {"case": "I2", "launch": "the I1 session after typing /effort xhigh", "recorded_effort_after_command": "xhigh",
         "recorded_efforts_in_order": ["max", "xhigh"]},
        {"case": "I3", "launch": "claude --model sonnet --effort xhigh (interactive)", "recorded_effort": "xhigh", "reminder_lines": 1},
        {"case": "I4", "launch": "claude -p <prompt> --model sonnet run inside a terminal", "recorded_effort": "xhigh", "reminder_lines": 1},
    ]


def binary_schema():
    with open(BINARY, "rb") as f:
        m = mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ)
        windows = [m[x.start():x.start() + 132].decode("utf8", "replace")
                   for pat in (rb"effortLevel:\(\)=>z\(\[", rb"u\(\{effortLevel:z\(\[") for x in re.finditer(pat, m)]
        gate = [m[x.start():x.start() + 80].decode("utf8", "replace") for x in re.finditer(rb"function sKn\(e\)\{", m)]
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        m.seek(0)
        for chunk in iter(lambda: m.read(1 << 22), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    assert windows and all('"max"' not in w and '["low","medium","high","xhigh"]' in w for w in windows), windows
    assert gate and "ultracode===!0" in gate[0] and "effort" not in gate[0].split("function B3")[0].replace("J$e(e)===\"ultracode\"", ""), gate
    return {"settings_schema_windows": windows, "ultracode_gate_function_head": gate, "binary_sha256": digest.hexdigest()}


def run_tests():
    def run(*modules):
        env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR="/var/tmp", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", *modules], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=1800)
        tail = r.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-4:]
        ran = re.search(r"Ran (\d+) tests", r.stderr)
        skipped = re.search(r"skipped=(\d+)", r.stderr)
        assert r.returncode == 0 and ran, r.stderr[-600:]
        return {"command": "python3 -m unittest " + " ".join(modules), "exit": r.returncode, "tests": int(ran.group(1)),
                "skipped": int(skipped.group(1)) if skipped else 0, "result_line": tail[-1] if tail else ""}
    return {"launcher_behavior_suite": run("tests.test_adoption_bootstrap.InteractiveEffortLauncherTests"),
            "both_bootstrap_suites": run("tests.test_adoption_bootstrap", "tests.test_adoption_bootstrap_macos")}


def host_state():
    now, backup, backup_v1 = open(HOST_LAUNCHER, "rb").read(), open(HOST_BACKUP, "rb").read(), open(HOST_BACKUP_V1, "rb").read()
    assert sha(now) == NEW_SHA and sha(backup) == OLD_SHA and sha(backup_v1) == V1_SHA, (sha(now), sha(backup), sha(backup_v1))
    mode = oct(os.stat(HOST_LAUNCHER).st_mode & 0o777)
    assert mode == "0o755", mode
    return {"launcher_path": "~/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/claude", "mode": "0755", "before_sha256": OLD_SHA, "before_bytes": len(backup),
            "first_applied_version_sha256": V1_SHA, "first_applied_version_bytes": len(backup_v1),
            "after_sha256": NEW_SHA, "after_bytes": len(now), "backups_kept_beside_it": True,
            "native_binary_version_it_execs": VERSION, "native_binary_reached_through": "~/.local/bin/claude"}


def build():
    probes = headless_rows()
    installed = interactive_rows("installed2", "as installed")
    schema = binary_schema()
    tests = run_tests()
    host = host_state()
    claim = (
        "Seventeen headless probes, four interactive terminal cases run through a login shell after the host launcher was replaced by the "
        "repository-generated one, the launcher's repository tests and the installed binary's settings schema, all on Claude Code 2.1.284 and each "
        "read from the model and effort the client recorded in its own transcript, found that: (1) with the host's saved xhigh per-model levels and "
        "ultracode true, a Sonnet 5.5 and an Opus 5.5 session ran at xhigh, and --effort max ran both at max with the Ultracode reminder present; "
        "(2) in a --effort max session a Workflow stage naming no effort and an unnamed subagent ran at max, a stage naming effort low ran at low and "
        "a subagent whose definition says medium ran at medium, whereas with CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max supplied through the --settings env layer "
        "the low stage and the medium subagent both ran at max and the variable also overrode an explicit --effort low; (3) --effort max with "
        "ultracode false ran at max with the reminder absent and its Workflow stages kept their own efforts; (4) the binary's settings schema lists "
        "only low, medium, high and xhigh for effortLevel and modelSettings.<model>.effortLevel, so a saved max is dropped, and its Ultracode gate "
        "reads the ultracode setting or an ultracode effort choice, with no effort term; (5) an interactive Sonnet 5.5 session started through a "
        "login shell with the installed launcher ran at max, ran at xhigh after /effort xhigh, ran at xhigh when launched with an explicit --effort "
        "xhigh, and claude -p inside a terminal ran at xhigh (the launcher went from 165 bytes to 1,810 bytes, through a first 911-byte version that a "
        "cross-family review sent back for repair); and (6) --effort max on Haiku 4.5 completed with exit 0 and empty stderr and no effort field was "
        "recorded for either Haiku run."
    )
    limitations = [
        "Local observation of one workstation and one client version (2.1.284); not a provider ledger, and the recorded effort field is the client's own per-message record, not an API-side confirmation.",
        "The headless probes are one-turn sessions in fresh scratch directories that read the host's user settings (shape only: ultracode true, a top-level effortLevel of xhigh, and per-model levels of xhigh for Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5); other settings would change the baselines.",
        "The environment-variable route was supplied through the --settings flag's env block (cases E1 to E4), not through a shell export or the user settings file, and the documented reapplication of settings env values to running sessions was not probed.",
        "For the three Workflow cases the Workflow tool result is only a launch receipt; execution is shown by the two child transcripts (attributed by the stage token in each child's first message, never by session id or file order), the workflow journal and the completion notification. The Ultracode reminder is matched as the full phrase 'Ultracode is on: optimize' and is an indicator, not proof of orchestration; orchestration was exercised only where the prompt ordered a Workflow launch.",
        "Haiku 4.5 rows carry no effort field at all (the client marks per-turn effort inactive), so the transcript cannot show what became of --effort max on that model.",
        "Each interactive case is one Sonnet 5.5 session driven through tmux with the workspace-trust dialog answered yes for a scratch directory (one entry added to the client's trust state); the /effort xhigh command re-saved the user settings file with identical bytes (its mtime moved, its sha256 did not). A first 911-byte version of the launcher went through the same four cases before a cross-family review sent it back for repair; those runs are not part of this receipt, and a later pre-flight of the repaired launcher lost two of its rows to a harness defect (a leftover transcript satisfied a reply check) and is not used either.",
        "Not covered: the VS Code extension, the desktop app and the web client, which do not go through the launcher; a host whose bin directory is ~/.local/bin, where no launcher is written; macOS (not run); and the Windows Terminal profile itself (the login-shell route it takes was exercised through tmux).",
        "An independent stack-verifier re-derived all seventeen headless rows from the raw transcripts with its own extraction code (17 of 17 matched); that verdict is recorded by the coordinator, not by a script in this receipt.",
        "The transcripts hold local identifiers and are not retained; the scripts in provenance reproduce every row given the results files they write, and scratch paths and session identifiers are replaced in them.",
        "Nothing here compares answer quality across effort levels; the vendor and third-party effort comparisons are cited in docs/decisions/2026-09-29-max-default-effort.md, not measured here.",
    ]
    scripts = {}
    for name in ("lib.sh", "run_c.sh", "run_f.sh", "run_e.sh", "run_h.sh", "read_probes.py", "interactive_e2e.py", "gen_launcher.py", "host_apply_launcher.py", "make_receipt_max.py"):
        scripts[name] = clean((HERE / name).read_text())
    receipt = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "id": RECEIPT_ID,
        "kind": "native_cli_e2e",
        "component_ids": ["claude-code"],
        "claim": claim,
        "limitations": limitations,
        "evidence_class": "independent observation: native Claude Code 2.1.284 headless and interactive sessions on this host, with the model and effort recorded per assistant message in each transcript, plus repository unit tests and a static read of the installed binary's settings schema",
        "recorded_at_utc": max(json.loads(l).get("timestamp", "") for l in open(sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(PROJECTS, "*", "*.jsonl")), key=os.path.getmtime)[-1]) if l.strip().startswith("{"))[:19] + "Z",
        "host_scope": {
            "host": "nativestack-5975wx-20260925",
            "platform": "NativeStack workstation, WSL2 Linux x86_64",
            "identity": "one workstation; the running user's Claude Code user settings (shape only) and the host's claude launcher",
        },
        "data": {
            "client_version": VERSION + " (Claude Code), recorded in every transcript read",
            "counting": "assistant message ids are counted once (a message spans several transcript rows); children are attributed by stage token",
            "headless_probes": probes,
            "interactive_installed_launcher": installed,
            "binary_schema": schema,
            "repository_tests": tests,
            "host_launcher": host,
        },
        "provenance": {
            "command": "bash run_c.sh; bash run_f.sh; bash run_e.sh; bash run_h.sh (each writes results-<group>.tsv, one line per case); "
                       "python3 gen_launcher.py <checkout> <dir>; python3 interactive_e2e.py preflight --launcher-dir <dir>; python3 host_apply_launcher.py <file> --apply; "
                       "python3 interactive_e2e.py installed; python3 make_receipt_max.py <checkout>",
            "script_sha256": {name: sha(scripts[name].encode()) for name in sorted(scripts)},
            "scripts": scripts,
        },
    }
    text = json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n"
    host_user = os.environ.get("USER") or Path.home().name  # the check must not spell the name itself: this file is embedded above
    assert host_user and host_user not in text, "the host user name is in the receipt"
    return receipt, text


receipt_file = ROOT / RECEIPT_PATH
if REGISTER_ONLY:
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    manifest_path = ROOT / "manifests/evidence.json"
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert all(r["id"] != RECEIPT_ID for r in manifest["receipts"]), "receipt already registered"
    entry = {k: receipt[k] for k in ("id", "kind", "component_ids", "claim", "limitations")}
    entry["path"] = RECEIPT_PATH
    manifest["receipts"].append(entry)
    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("registered", RECEIPT_ID)
else:
    receipt, text = build()
    receipt_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    receipt_file.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print("wrote", RECEIPT_PATH, "recorded_at_utc", receipt["recorded_at_utc"], "bytes", len(text))
